dispositions.title: Askey–Szegő problem
dispositions.note: Askey-Szego problem: classify triples (a,b,c)>0 with 1F2(a;b,c;-x)>0 for all x>0. Substantial public literature touches exactly this: Cho-Chung-Yun, 'Newton diagram of positivity for 1F2' (arXiv:1801.02312, Integral Transforms Spec. Funct. 2018, claims necessary and sufficient conditions/positivity region) and 'Rational extension of the Newton diagram ... and Askey-Szego problem' (arXiv:1805.11855, Constr. Approx. 2019); a formal Correction to the latter was published 2026-08-29 (doi:10.1007/s00365-026-09773-4) and is the MathDB source. Whether the full 3-parameter classification stands after the correction is a body-level question. PARKED for separate source-qualification (abstracts retained; proof bodies not inspected); not low-hanging now. Sources: sources/392617/.

dispositions.title: Classification of four-integer sets with pairwise square condition
dispositions.note: Four-integer sets D with xy+x+y a perfect square for all distinct pairs: substitute u=x+1; u_i u_j - 1 must be a square for all pairs (a D(-1)-quadruple in Z). Mixed signs impossible (u_i u_j - 1 < 0), u=0 impossible, so all u_i>0 or all u_i<0; the all-negative case is the negation mirror of the positive case, which is the classical D(-1)-quadruple conjecture - resolved: Bonciocat-Cipu-Mignotte, 'There is no Diophantine D(-1)-quadruple' (arXiv:2010.09200, 2020; J. London Math. Soc., doi:10.1112/jlms.12507), which itself covers integer entries. Abstract retained: sources/394494/.
